text: Built a Python service that processes and validates structured data from multiple third-party APIs.
Implemented a multi-agent pipeline using LangGraph and a custom MCP server to automate a multi-step data workflow.
Fine-tuned an open-source transformer model and benchmarked it against a closed-source API on accuracy, latency, and cost.
Ran a multi-agent research project studying behavioral drift and hallucination propagation across LLM pipelines.
Interviewed a cohort of target users, wrote a PRD, and prioritized a feature backlog using a RICE framework.
Shipped a staged product rollout (v1-v3) to real users and tracked weekly adoption metrics to guide the roadmap.
